paxillus.definition:
n. One of a peculiar kind of spines covering the surface of
   certain starfishes. They are pillarlike, with a flattened summit which
   is covered with minute spinules or granules. See Illustration in
   Appendix.

paxwax.definition:
n. The strong ligament of the back of the neck in quadrupeds.
   It connects the back of the skull with dorsal spines of the cervical
   vertebrae, and helps to support the head. Called also paxywaxy and
   packwax.
paxwax.translation:
n. 项部韧带
[医] 颈韧带
